page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t6-c1m2.large is a burstable instance type powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It features 2 vCPUs derived from a single physical core with hyper-threading enabled, resulting in 2 threads per core. The instance is configured with 4.0 GB of RAM, providing 2.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and operates under a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 0 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks position this instance in the lower tiers. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance score is 1300.19, and the multi-core score is 2402.69, both falling into the bottom 25% category. Memory bandwidth tests show 186.46 GB/sec for cached small blocks, but this drops to 20.68 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, indicating a bottleneck during memory-intensive operations. Geekbench scores reflect similar constraints, with a single-core score of 1045.0 and a multi-core score of 1850.0.

Due to its burstable CPU allocation and modest resource footprint, the ecs.t6-c1m2.large is designed for low-utilization or intermittent workloads. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for development environments, code repositories, lightweight microservices, and basic static web serving, where continuous high CPU performance is not required. It is not suitable for memory-intensive databases, heavy multi-threaded processing, or machine learning tasks.
